summary: Haptic feedback feature (VA.haptic in app.js used by boot.js/player.js/story.js) fully verified. Stub Telegram.WebApp.HapticFeedback was injected by patching the real Telegram object at page load (its property is non-configurable but methods are writable). All 4 haptic scenarios pass: nav tap → i:light, correct practice answer (m1p:call) → n:success, wrong practice answer (m4p:call, answer=put) → n:error, lesson completion (m1l1 → next twice) → n:success + toast 'Урок пройден ✓'. Regression: practice verdicts '✓ Верно' / '✕ Неверно' render correctly; profile counters display (1/50 lessons, 0/13 practices). No-stub (plain browser) case: practice answering works, verdicts correct, no app-level console errors — VA.haptic's try/catch swallows unsupported-version warnings from real Telegram gracefully.
action_items: Optional: consider incrementing 'Практик решено верно' counter when a correct practice answer is picked — profile showed 0/13 after a correct m1p answer during the session (may be pre-existing; not in scope of haptic feature).

Note: Telegram Web-App version reported by preview is 6.0 which prints 'HapticFeedback is not supported in version 6.0' warnings. VA.haptic swallows these safely via try/catch — no code change required. In a real Telegram client v6.1+ the calls will actually fire.
critical_code_review_comments: VA.haptic (app.js:64) correctly guards Telegram.WebApp.HapticFeedback existence and falls back to navigator.vibrate; wrapped in try/catch so unsupported-version rejections cannot break the flow.
boot.js:32 emits impact 'light' on delegated bottom-nav tap (before hash navigation) — good ordering.
player.js:71 emits 'success' only when P().markDone returns truthy (i.e., lesson not already done) — prevents duplicate success on re-finish; matches spec.
player.js:97 emits 'success' or 'error' based on choice correctness — matches spec.
story.js:92 emits 'success' inside the story funnel completion — not requested for this iteration but consistent.
seed_data_creation: None (used localStorage va_uid='demo' to bypass funnel per spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The preview environment always loads real Telegram Web-App v6.0 (from https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js) which reports HapticFeedback unsupported. To assert haptic calls, do NOT rely on add_init_script setting window.Telegram — the real script overwrites it. Instead, after page load, patch the methods on the real object: Telegram.WebApp.HapticFeedback.impactOccurred = ...; Telegram.WebApp.HapticFeedback.notificationOccurred = ...;. The property descriptor is {configurable:false, writable:false} on WebApp, but the HapticFeedback object's own methods are writable. Also: the bottom-nav testID for lessons is 'nav-learn' (not 'nav-lessons'); m4p practice lives in module-4 so use nav-practice (the 'All practices' list) rather than practice-back-button when jumping between modules.
